segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: most say it's tolerable if used briefly, some limiting it to two to three minutes to avoid redness, and report no breakouts even with acne-prone sensitive skin; a few, though, say it burned their skin or isn't suited for sensitive skin at all.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin 'the driest on the planet,' report improved texture, softness, and fewer visible wrinkles with regular use; one limits use to summer months since winter dryness makes her skin more reactive.
segments.oily: Reviewers managing oily skin, including one with an oily T-zone, report it works well and leaves them feeling less oily throughout the day.
segments.combination: One 39-year-old reviewer with an oily T-zone and a very dry outer perimeter, plus sun spots and acne, reports brighter, smoother skin using it every four or more days.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes her skin as 'maturing' at 39 and reports brighter, smoother results alongside improvement in her sun spots and acne.

concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the scrub caused over 100 new breakouts and 'destroyed' her skin after two weeks of use; many others, though, including some with acne-prone skin, report it cleared or reduced their breakouts, bumps, and body acne with no new blemishes.
concerns.redness: One reviewer limits use to under two minutes to avoid her skin turning red; another with sensitive skin says it burned and left her disappointed.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers, including one with sun spots as part of aging, oily-T-zone skin, report their dark spots noticeably faded or lightened within a couple of weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers managing oiliness report it works well for their skin type and leaves them feeling less oily throughout the day.
concerns.aging: One reviewer with very dry skin says she noticed less texture and fewer visible wrinkles with daily use.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers say it doesn't dry out their skin further, though one limits use to summer months since winter already leaves her skin more dry and reactive, and another pairs it with a moisturizer to manage residual flakiness.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way
Weaker than the discontinued walnut scrub
Doubles as a body or chest exfoliant
Off or inconsistent scent in some batches

extraits.texte: This product made my entire face break out. I have been using the same cleanser and toner for a decade and this scrub was the only new product in my lineup. After two weeks of usage, it destroyed my skin and made me break out in more than 100 breakouts. Yes I counted. I cannot believe this product did this to my skin. I think it's too late for a refund, but please save yourself and your skin.

I have a very mixed review on this product for a few different reasons. Starting with the positive, I did like how soft it left my skin after using BUT, having sensitive skin, it did burn while I used it and I thought it would smell better for a facial scrub. Overall, I probably won't use it again because it did really burn my skin. If it was made with gentler ingredients I would consider using it!

I love using this exfoliating scrub! Ive tried other brands (PTR & Dermologica) but the exfoliating particles always felt too small. With the OLEHENRIKSEN scrub the particles are a little larger and I can actually feel the smoothness after! I have maturing 39 yr old skin, with an oily T zone & very dry outer perimeter, with sun spots, and acne. I let the scrub sit for a few minutes while I'm in the shower and will do that every 4 or more days. My skin is brighter, smoother, and it helps my makeup application look flawless as well!

extraits.titre: Love this, on my fourth tube...
extraits.texte: I've been using this scrub for a couple years now, probably about once a week since I have pretty sensitive skin and any more would cause problems. I have dry, sensitive skin so once I find something that works and doesn't cause damage to my skin - or hurt - I try to stick with it. I don't really have a problem with pores other than some in the crease between my bottom lip and chin, but this does amazing for my dry skin. I only use it in the summer when the heat isn't on constantly and drying out my skin and making it more sensitive (as opposed to winter), so I go through about a tube per summer (late spring and early fall).
Great for people with Oily skin. Noticed lightning of my dark spots after a couple of weeks.
I have the driest skin on the planet and i use this everyday. Noticeable change in texture and wrinkles. And my skin is so soft now. Search no more.
I have extremely sensitive acne prone skin and this product has not broken me out at all! My skin is literally the clearest its been in years and glowing!
